 UPESSC TGT Recruitment 2026: Notification, Vacancy, Apply Online
 Download PDF Meghana Mohana Krishnan Updated on 26 Oct 2026, 02:23 PM IST 
 Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission activated the UPESSC TGT apply link 2026 on October 23, 2026, at upessc.up.gov.in. The UPESSC TGT 2026 application last date is November 26, 2026. The UPESSC TGT notification and application form were released simultaneously. A total of 17735 UPESSC vacancies 2026 have been released.

 The UPESSC TGT exam is scheduled to be conducted on December 23 and 24, 2026. Any change in the UPESSC TGT 2026 exam date will be shared on the official website. The UPESSC TGT recruitment 2026 is being conducted for the selection of candidates for the post of Assistant Teacher. Go through the article below to know more about the UPESSC TGT recruitment.

 UPESSC TGT Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria 
 The UPESSC TGT eligibility criteria are specified in the official notification. Candidates must go through the detailed UPESSC TGT 2026 eligibility carefully before applying. They might lose their candidature if they fail to meet the UPESSC TGT eligibility. Below are the UPESSC eligibility criteria -
 Age limit - Minimum age limit - 21 years.
 Educational qualification - Graduation in the specific subject with minimum 50% marks or Master’s degree with minimum 45%/ B.Ed. in a course recognised by NCTE.
 Must have passed the TET exam for upper primary level.

 UPESSC TGT Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
 The UPESSC TGT 2026 selection process is as per the merit of the candidate in the written exam, which is conducted for 360 marks. If more than one candidate has the same merit, then the candidate with the highest percentage in graduation is considered. Further, a document verification round is conducted for the selected candidates. 
 UPESSC TGT Recruitment 2026 Salary 
 The UPESSC TGT salary is specified in the official notification. The UPESSC Assistant Teacher salary is as per Pay Level 7. The UPESSC TGT salary range 2026 is between Rs 44,900 and Rs 1,42,400.
